items.title: Fix Template ID Mismatch in Style Editor
items.description: The style editor incorrectly passes user template IDs (from `templates` table) to the systemTemplates query, causing ArgumentValidationError. When editing a template, StyleEditorContent must properly distinguish between system templates (using systemTemplateId URL param) and user templates (using templateId URL param) and call the appropriate query/hook.
acceptance_criteria: StyleEditorContent correctly identifies template type from URL params
systemTemplateId param routes to useSystemTemplate hook
templateId param routes to useTemplate hook (user templates)
No ArgumentValidationError when editing user templates
No ArgumentValidationError when editing system templates
Quick-edit button in admin templates uses systemTemplateId param
Edit action in user styles uses templateId param
Both template types load and save correctly in style editor
steps_to_verify: Check StyleEditorContent.tsx for URL param handling
Verify useSystemTemplate is only called with systemTemplates IDs
Verify useTemplate is only called with templates IDs
Navigate to /admin/templates as admin
Click quick-edit pencil on a system template - verify editor loads without error
Navigate to /styles as regular user
Click edit on a user template - verify editor loads without error
Make changes and save - verify both template types save correctly
Check browser console for any ArgumentValidationError

items.title: Add Layers Tab to Style Editor
items.description: Implement a Layers panel as a new tab in the PropertiesPanel, positioned before the History tab. The layers panel displays a hierarchical tree view of all template elements with expand/collapse functionality, inline lock/visibility toggles, a 3-dot action menu for additional operations, full drag-and-drop reparenting between containers, and click-to-select with automatic canvas scrolling.
acceptance_criteria: Layers tab appears in PropertiesPanel before History tab
Tab shows Layers icon and 'Layers' label
Tree displays all template elements with proper hierarchy
Container elements show expand/collapse chevrons
Children are nested under their parent containers
Each element shows type-specific icon (text, table, divider, rectangle, logo, container)
Element names are displayed and truncated if too long
Clicking an element selects it on the canvas
Clicking an element scrolls the canvas to bring it into view
Lock icon appears on hover, toggles element.locked state
Eye icon appears on hover, toggles element.visible state
3-dot menu appears on hover with Duplicate, Delete, Move to Container options
Duplicate creates a copy of the element
Delete removes the element
Move to Container opens dialog to select target container
Elements can be dragged to reparent into containers
Dragging to a container updates parentId and positionMode
Cannot drag a container into itself or its descendants
Locked elements cannot be dragged
Container child count badge shown when collapsed
steps_to_verify: Navigate to /style-editor and load a template with nested elements
Click Layers tab in right panel - verify it appears before History
Verify tree structure matches element hierarchy
Click chevron on container - verify children expand/collapse
Click an element in layers - verify it's selected on canvas
Verify canvas scrolls to show the selected element
Hover over element - verify lock and eye icons appear
Click lock icon - verify element becomes locked on canvas
Click eye icon - verify element visibility toggles
Click 3-dot menu - verify Duplicate, Delete, Move to Container options
Click Duplicate - verify new element created
Click Delete - verify element removed
Click Move to Container - verify dialog opens with container list
Select container and confirm - verify element moves into container
Drag element onto container - verify it becomes child
Try dragging locked element - verify it doesn't drag
Try dragging container into itself - verify it's prevented
